description: This file defines classes, enums, and functions related to a D-Bus client implementation for process container management within the WPEFramework. It includes definitions for application states, asynchronous results, connection states, and a Client class that manages D-Bus communication and container lifecycle events.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: Enumeration representing various states of an application/container, such as STARTED, STOPPED, SUSPENDED, etc.

classes.name: ThreadGuard
classes.description: Utility class that manages a thread, ensuring it is joined upon destruction.

classes.name: AsyncResult
classes.description: Enumeration indicating the result of an asynchronous operation, such as Pending, Timeout, OK, or NOK.

classes.name: ConnState
classes.description: Enumeration representing the connection state, such as Pending, Connected, or Disconnected.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Main class managing D-Bus communication for process containers, including connection handling, state change notifications, and container lifecycle management.

classes.name: Interface
classes.description: Abstract class defining the interface for container control, including methods for handling state changes and starting/stopping containers.

methods.name: toStr
methods.description: Converts an AppState enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: quit
methods.description: Terminates the client's D-Bus connection and associated resources.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a shared interface to the client for communication.

methods.name: unbind
methods.description: Unbinds a shared interface from the client.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the D-Bus.

methods.name: waitForResult
methods.description: Waits for an asynchronous operation to complete or timeout.

methods.name: connectionResetIfNeeded
methods.description: Resets the connection if needed, with an optional timeout.

methods.name: connectBus
methods.description: Connects to the D-Bus bus with a specified timeout.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the main loop or processing logic.

methods.name: findInterface
methods.description: Finds and returns a shared interface based on a string identifier.

methods.name: quit
methods.description: Quits the client, cleaning up resources.
